Continue without empty promises

Express your interest and maintain continuity in your learning.

Interest without a concrete need makes it difficult to choose the right support.

You can share what you want to learn and receive a path consistent with your starting point.

Describe your situation, desired result and what you have tried so far.

A useful request provides enough context to guide the next contact without advance promises.

01

What this form means

It lets you express interest. Any additional step must be communicated explicitly and separately.

02

Nothing is assumed

The path separates three actions to keep expectations clear.

  • Explore Level 0
  • Register interest
  • Act only on published information
03

Keep practising in the meantime

Choose another question, work with new sources and test whether you can explain the method without looking at an earlier answer.

04

Register interest

Sharing the form does not change your status in the path. You keep the decision over any later step.
